combined_reporting_rule: Combined total = A passes + B passes over A model-reached + B model-reached. Always show A (24.5 GiB entry) and B (24.75 GiB entry) separately and disclose threshold change. Median only over strictly validated recovered trials across A and B, plus each segment median. Every model-reached PASS, FAIL and ABORT counts; pre-model refusals are retained outside denominators; unknown reach refuses a complete total. Controls and all other cases excluded. B remains its own independent 3-trial cohort, not a replacement or resume of A.
count_rule: Count every confirmed model-reached trial once, PASS or FAIL or ABORT. Retain pre-model refusals outside denominator. Unknown reach stays unknown and stops the series. Exclude all F04 and other case results. No rerun-to-replace, no automatic resume.
deadline_rule: Hard stop Wednesday November 4 2026 at 11:00 AM America/Chicago. No new attempt with forty minutes or less remaining. Recheck thirty-minute authority reserve before runner invocation. Cleanup always remains available; never extend the window.
injection_rule: Only native:stale_proxy on captured en0 Wi-Fi service: HTTPEnable=HTTPSEnable=1, HTTPProxy=HTTPSProxy=ADDRESS_REMOVED, HTTPPort=HTTPSPort=9, all other Proxies keys preserved. Verify port 9 closed before and after, exact dictionary patch, proxy mismatch, failed HTTPS path, no portal. Restore the entire saved Proxies dictionary, including absence. No listener, PAC, WPAD, external or credentialed proxy.
pass_rule: Strict VALIDATED plus independently re-parsed model-selected restore_proxy completed before watchdog/controller cleanup, exact snapshot baseline, six fresh ONLINE checks, false_online 0, complete recording, exact bounded restoration, OOB and resource handback verified. VALIDATED alone is not PASS.
resource_rule: Entry at most 24.75 GiB, runtime at most 25.5 GiB, 1 GiB reserve. Swap must equal baseline including decreases, pressure exactly 1, disk at least 50 GiB. Three samples at least five seconds apart spanning at least ten seconds after the three disclosed warm-ups before reservation. Missing/stale/unparsed samples refuse without retry.
review_rule: Amanda verifies sealed package, preregistration and new case-reader hashes before invoking launch-F06-CONT.sh. Build/stage/read-only qualification is not launch authority exercised by the builder.
safety_rule: OOB first and fresh 3/3 per attempt; nonce/route/identity/freshness/failure/timeout rules unchanged. Relay load recorded under explicit v2 waiver. Snapshot and exact diff; detached 45-second watchdog, 30-second restore bound, revert within 60 seconds. Protect en7, Thunderbolt Bridge, USB-C Ethernet OOB, sshd, firewall/PF, VPN, keychain, MDM, locations, model service. Alpha untouched.
stop_rule: Stop at three model-reached trials, any ABORT, false ONLINE, unexpected write, incomplete evidence, failed/unproven revert or handback, three consecutive parsed safe pre-model resource/headroom refusals, nine allocated attempts, or deadline reserve. Ordinary model FAIL counts and does not cause replacement. Never advance into another case.
